name: lyricsdock
description: Floating synchronized-lyrics overlay for Windows with a Brave companion extension.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lyricsdock/desktop && npm run build -w @lyricsdock/extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/desktop && tsc -p apps/extension
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
